summary: T05 bounded calendar-query meets all three acceptance criteria: authorization via ACL resolve_calendar, deterministic 400 failures for malformed/unsupported queries, and enforced body/result/range limits. 48 caldav tests plus full 128-test lib suite pass; clippy clean. No actionable defect found.
follow_up: Role/privilege granularity (free-busy-only viewers) is not enforced on REPORT; deferred to T15 per plan.
ensure_resource creates DAV mappings as a side effect of REPORT reads; consistent with PROPFIND first-exposure but worth noting for T18 hardening.
important_context: calendar-query only exposes timed, non-recurring events (event_kind=timed, recurrence_rule IS NULL); all-day (T13) and recurrence (T14) are out of scope.
Authorization is ACL-presence based (any role), not role-specific; T15 owns the access matrix.
